svg.title: LLD — one MCP shell call, end to end
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.text: Every tool passes through one place, so the audit log cannot grow holes as tools are added.

g.data-edge-label: spawn detached, after the deny list and the jail

g.text: spawn detached, after the deny list and the jail

g.desc: Use arrow keys to explore relationships. Press Enter or Space to pin details; Escape clears.
